format: English (NA/EU/OC/LATAM/ME) Standard Regulation, Blocks 2-5 legal (Apr 1 2026 - Mar 31 2027); newest legal booster OP17 (released 2026-08-28); banned/restricted list effective 2026-10-12 (OP14-020 banned)
countingMethod: Sum of final placings 1-8 per leader card ID across 33 Limitless-platform online Standard events (24+ players, decklists published) from 2026-08-26 to 2026-11-24, written by npm run meta:update. Skipped: Extra Regulation events, events with a card not in the card snapshot (not yet released in English), and decklists that break the current Standard list (banned, rotated, over a restricted limit). metaShare = percent of all 1968 counted decklists. Archetypes: the top 12 leaders by top-8 count, plus any earlier archetype (kept until a person removes it).
tierNote: tier (onepiece.gg) is null for every archetype: onepiece.gg robots.txt disallows anthropic-ai and Claude-Web, so its pages were not opened. tierOpmetagame is from https://opmetagame.com/tier-list/ (OP-17 meta, October 2026), mapped by leader name and color.
